# Ctxo MCP Server

> AI agents don't fail because they can't code. They fail because they code blind. Ctxo gives them the full picture before they write a single line.

Ctxo is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI agents structured context about codebases: symbol graphs, blast radius, architectural overlays, change intelligence, dead code detection, and PR impact analysis.

## Quick Start

```
npm install -g @ctxo/cli   # One-time global install (gives you the `ctxo` command)
ctxo init                  # Rules, skills, guard, MCP config, git hooks, plugins
ctxo index                 # Build codebase index
ctxo                       # Start MCP server (stdio)
```

## Package Layout (pnpm monorepo)

- `@ctxo/cli` - CLI + MCP server (formerly `ctxo-mcp`)
- `@ctxo/plugin-api` - `CtxoLanguagePlugin` interface, protocol v1 and v2 (`SUPPORTED_API_VERSIONS = ['1', '2']`; v2 adds data kinds, annotations, facts on request and host capabilities)
- `@ctxo/lang-typescript` - ts-morph full-tier plugin
- `@ctxo/lang-go` - ctxo-go-analyzer (full tier, Go 1.22+) + tree-sitter plugin
- `@ctxo/lang-csharp` - Roslyn plugin (attribute annotations; SQL edges at known call sites when `@ctxo/lang-sql` is installed)
- `@ctxo/lang-java` - tree-sitter Java plugin (syntax tier built-in; full tier via `@ctxo/lang-java-analyzer` companion, requires JRE 11+)
- `@ctxo/lang-sql` - T-SQL plugin for `.sql` files (protocol v2): tables, views, procedures, functions and their reads/writes/executes
- `@ctxo/domain` - opt-in domain knowledge layer (ADR-018): named contexts, cards, the fold guard and the `verify-domain` CI gate; loaded by the CLI through `@ctxo/cli/internal`, shares one version with `@ctxo/cli`
- `@ctxo/sql-extract` - zero-dependency T-SQL tokenizer and recognizers (a library, not a plugin; the one dependency plugins may take besides `@ctxo/plugin-api`)

Language adapters ship as separate npm packages and are discovered by scanning the project `package.json` for `@ctxo/lang-*` or `ctxo-lang-*` dependencies.

## Tools: 14 core, plus 4 with @ctxo/domain (18)

- get_logic_slice: Symbol + transitive dependencies (L1-L4 detail levels)
- get_blast_radius: What breaks if a symbol changes (3-tier: confirmed/likely/potential; data edges are confirmed)
- get_architectural_overlay: Project layer map (Domain/Infrastructure/Adapter), Louvain communities, and candidate bounded contexts (mode: "contexts")
- get_why_context: Git commit intent + anti-pattern warnings (reverts, rollbacks)
- get_change_intelligence: Complexity x churn composite score
- find_dead_code: Unreachable symbols and files
- get_context_for_task: Task-optimized context (fix/extend/refactor/understand)
- get_ranked_context: BM25 + PageRank search within token budget
- search_symbols: Symbol name/regex search across index
- get_changed_symbols: Symbols in recently changed files (git diff)
- find_importers: Reverse dependency lookup ("who uses this?")
- get_class_hierarchy: Class inheritance tree (ancestors + descendants)
- get_symbol_importance: PageRank centrality ranking
- get_pr_impact: Full PR risk assessment in a single call
- get_domain_context (with @ctxo/domain): the card of the named context that owns a symbol or file: terms, rules with tests and code links, contracts, decisions, open questions. Parameters: `symbolId?`, `path?`; with neither, every context
- get_rule (with @ctxo/domain): one rule by ID (`ruleId`, variants such as LEND03 also match): text, context, tests with the source of each link, implementing symbols, decisions and provenance
- find_shadow_specs (with @ctxo/domain): shadow-spec candidates of a context, business-looking code no card rule pins yet (literal comparisons, normalization, retry and timeout values, endpoints, owned tables, views and procedures, rules without tests), each with file, line, symbol, a line-independent fingerprint, its source and its resolution. Parameters: `context` (required), `kinds?` (empty or omitted: all kinds), `includeResolved?` (default false)
- get_context_map (with @ctxo/domain): per context its card, rules and test share, characterization and contract tests, cross-context edges, co-change, drift, boundary violations, open candidates, the owner's rung, a suggested rung and the status of each criterion (pinned, named, bounded, boring); while the domain conventions are at their defaults and the last index found that discovery would add something, its hint names `ctxo domain discover` (the "no registry" and "no domain graph" hints name it too). No parameters

## Tool Selection Guide

- Reviewing a PR? -> get_pr_impact
- About to modify code? -> get_blast_radius
- Understanding a symbol? -> get_context_for_task(taskType: "understand")
- Fixing a bug? -> get_context_for_task(taskType: "fix")
- Refactoring? -> get_context_for_task(taskType: "refactor")
- Don't know the symbol name? -> search_symbols or get_ranked_context
- Finding unused code? -> find_dead_code
- Safe to delete? -> find_importers
- Preparing a context map? -> get_architectural_overlay(mode: "contexts")
- Need the business rules or decisions behind code? -> get_domain_context, then get_rule (with @ctxo/domain)
- Running the Deletion Test? -> find_shadow_specs, then get_rule (with @ctxo/domain)
- How mature is each context? -> get_context_map (with @ctxo/domain)

## New in the next release: fact detectors, the Deletion Test loop and the context map (#156, PR 4)

- Fact kinds: `literal-comparison` (a comparison with a non-trivial literal in a condition; detail `operator`, `literal`), `normalization` (`ToLower*`, `Trim*`, `toLowerCase`, `strings.TrimSpace` and the rest of `domain.facts.normalizationMethods`; not for log, error, display or format calls, inner chain calls or tests (FC-4b); detail `method`), `retry-timeout` (a numeric constant bound to a name with a retry, timeout, delay, backoff, ttl or expir token, or a duration constructor; detail `name`, `value`, for example `HoldTimeout = 90min`), `endpoint` (ASP.NET attributes and minimal APIs, Express, Fastify, Koa, Hono, Nest, Spring, JAX-RS, `net/http`, gin, echo, chi, Flask decorators in the text scan; Express and Koa `use` mounts, Koa `prefix`, Hono `route`/`basePath`, gin and echo `Group`, chi `Route`/`Group`/`With`/`Mount` and same-file Flask Blueprint `url_prefix` prefixes are joined when the mount and the routes are in the same file and every segment is a constant, never guessed; detail `verb`, `route`).
- The TypeScript, C#, Java and Go plugins detect them in every tier they have (both tiers of C#, Java and Go; ts-morph for TypeScript) with one shared rule set and the conformance vectors `packages/plugin-api/conformance/fact-vectors.json`; at most 500 facts per file, text at most 200 code points, no `retry-timeout` facts in test files; TypeScript `typeof` guards give no facts; a fact extraction failure warns on stderr and gives `facts: []`. With `@ctxo/domain` and its registry file (`domain.registry`), or `index.facts: true`, every indexed file of these languages gets `facts` (possibly `[]`) on the next re-index: run a full `ctxo index` once after upgrading and after adding the registry. Without a registry `@ctxo/domain` requests no facts. Other files get facts from the `@ctxo/domain` text scan (`source: "text"`).
- Two tools: find_shadow_specs and get_context_map (14 core tools, 18 with `@ctxo/domain`). Fingerprints are `kind | symbol | normalized text`, independent of line numbers; a multi-dot file name stays one segment (`loan.service.ts::withRetry` gives `loan.service.withRetry`). Copy them verbatim into `shadow-specs.yaml` as YAML single-quoted scalars (`fingerprint: '...'`, a `'` inside written `''`), the form `ctxo domain shadow-specs` prints (`%7C` and `%25` in the symbol part are an encoded `|` and `%`). Resolutions: a rule link from card `Code:` lines or `rule:` comments, an `Untested:` line, or `<registry folder>/<context>/shadow-specs.yaml` entries `{ fingerprint, resolution: { rule: LEND-03 } | { notARule: "<reason>" } }` (schema `packages/domain/schema/shadow-specs.schema.json`).
- Rungs: pinned (`domain.rungs.pinnedCoverage`, default 0.8, of the endpoint and contract symbols reached from characterization tests), named (a card whose Language terms are all in the glossary), bounded (contract symbols reached from contract tests, no boundary violations), boring (every rule tested, no open candidate). The ladder is cumulative and every criterion is reported.
- Commands: `ctxo domain map [--json]` and `ctxo domain shadow-specs <context> [--kinds <k,...>] [--all] [--json]` (exit 0 done, also with stale data and a hint, or no registry, 1 bad arguments or an unknown context, 2 registry problems, no index data, index data from another registry or an internal error `[ctxo] domain <name> failed: <message>`; repeated `--kinds` add up); `ctxo verify-domain` check 12 (twelve checks): stale resolutions, unknown rules and orphan files warn, a broken file errors, and `stale resolutions were not checked: <reason>` warns when the candidates cannot be built; `ctxo domain discover` proposes Characterization and Contract paths, and its printed config quotes every list value, so it is valid YAML to paste.
- Config: `domain.facts` (`trivialLiterals`, `normalizationMethods`, `textScanExtensions`), `domain.tests.characterization` and `domain.tests.contract` (`annotations`, `paths`, `names`), `domain.rungs.pinnedCoverage`. Artifacts: `.ctxo/index/domain/shadow-candidates.json` and `maturity.json` (refreshed by `ctxo index` and `ctxo watch`, with `graph.json`; both removed when the graph builds but the candidates or maturity facts fail, so the tools answer "run ctxo index"; both kept, with the old graph, when the graph build fails). The `ctxo-domain-fold` skill marker is v0.16.

## The domain graph (0.15.0, #156, PR 3)

- `ctxo index` builds `.ctxo/index/domain/graph.json` from the cards and the glossary: rules linked to tests (xUnit `Trait` with a `domain.tests.ruleTraitKeys` key, NUnit `Category`, MSTest `TestCategory`, JUnit `Tag`, test titles, `rule:` comments, ID mentions in test files, card `Tests:` lines) and to code (card `Code:` lines, `rule: LEND-03` comments above declarations), decisions linked to provenance (repo files; `#123` and URLs kept as strings, never fetched), terms linked to symbol and table names. Rebuilt by `ctxo index`, the post-commit hook and `ctxo watch` (after a card, glossary or registry edit, at least 1 s and twice the last pass; after `watch.snapshotMinFileChanges` re-indexed source files; once at start when stale); until then the tools add `stale: true`.
- Fields with a graph (capped at 50, `decisions` at 5, `<name>Total` when cut, not truncatable): get_blast_radius `rulesAffected`, `cardsToUpdate`; get_why_context `decisions` (rule-linked first, then newest, with provenance); get_context_for_task `cardExcerpt` (target and neighbour rules, terms, contracts; within `tokenBudget`, up to a quarter reserved); get_pr_impact `contextsTouched` (merge base of `since` and HEAD plus the working tree), `cardsChanged`, `rulesWithoutTests`.
- Two tools, get_domain_context and get_rule: 14 core tools, 18 with `@ctxo/domain` (16 in 0.15.0, before find_shadow_specs and get_context_map). Both answer `{ found: false, hint }` without a registry or a graph.
- get_ranked_context gains `scope` with `@ctxo/domain`: `"code"` (default, unchanged) or `"domain"` (BM25 over rules, terms, decisions, card sections and in-repo provenance files; `strategy` and `searchMode` do not apply). Without the package there is no `scope` parameter.
- Card format additions (no code change needed): `Code:` lines, `**Term**` items, glossary `(context: <id>)`, dated decision lines. `Tests:`/`Code:` values with `::` are symbol IDs; use `file#Name` for a plain test name. `verify-domain` check 6 also errors on missing `Code:` files and directories, and warns on unindexed symbol IDs and unknown IDs in production `rule:` comments of a rule prefix.
- `@ctxo/cli` no longer publishes source maps (tarball about 0.8 MB unpacked). Internal API: async enrichers, `reserveTaskContextTokens`, `rankedContextScopes`, host services `createDocumentSearch`, `splitIdentifier`, `dataResourceKinds` (ADR-018 addendum).

## Domain knowledge layer, `@ctxo/domain` (0.14.0, #156 PR 2B)

- Install: `ctxo install domain` (globally when the project has no `package.json`), then `ctxo init --domain`. Opt-in: without the package, no commands, fields or hooks, and a known domain command name prints an install hint and exits 1 (`ctxo domain-guard-hook` exits 0 without output). With the package but no registry, the domain commands print a hint and exit 0 and no `context` fields appear.
- Registry `docs/domain/contexts.yaml`: contexts with `id`, `name`, `card`, `paths`, `rung` (fear, pinned, named, bounded, boring), `rulePrefix`, `contracts`; `unowned.allow`, `glossary`, `contextMap`. A card has five H2 headings (Language; Rules and invariants; Boundary contracts; Decisions; Open questions) and rules as `### LEND-03 title` with optional `Tests:`, `Code:` and `Untested:` lines.
- Commands: `ctxo contexts-touched [--since <ref>] [--committed | --staged] [--json] [--check]`; `ctxo verify-domain [--since <ref>] [--boundaries by-rung|report] [--json]` (exit 0, 1 or 2; `--json` stdout is empty on exit 2 and with no registry); `ctxo domain rules --write | --check`; `ctxo domain discover [--json] [--write]` (run it first when adopting or tuning the domain config: external IDs such as CWE or ISO keys, GitHub `#N` issues and lowercase `name-NN` branch families are evidence only, never proposed; characterization and contract markers come from Trait or Category values that name the kind, custom attributes such as `StorageContractFact` and `**/*ContractTests.cs` path globs, not only folders; a file named after a non-test class is left out of its glob, which is proposed on the other files); `ctxo init --domain [--boundaries <mode>]` and `--only domain`.
- Fold guard (Claude Code): `ctxo domain-guard-hook` on SessionStart, Stop and TaskCompleted blocks once when the session's commits changed a context without a card change; resolve with a card commit or the trailer `Domain-Unchanged: <id>[, <id>] (reason)`.
- Fold reminder (Cursor): `ctxo domain-cursor-hook` in `.cursor/hooks.json` on beforeSubmitPrompt (records the start once, always answers exactly `{"continue":true}`, a repeat prompt without loading the module) and stop; on a `status: "completed"` stop, same decision as the Claude guard, printed as `{"followup_message":...}` at most once per conversation; quiet with `loop_count` above 0, `domain.guard.enabled: false` or any error; never blocks.
- Config `domain:` in `.ctxo/config.yaml`: `registry`, `coverage.unowned` (warn | error), `boundaries.enforce` (by-rung | report) and `blockingRungs`, `rules.idPattern` and `trackerPrefixes`, `tests.ruleTraitKeys`, `guard.enabled`, `guard.base`, `guard.subagents`.
- Additive fields with `@ctxo/domain` and a registry: `context` on search_symbols, get_blast_radius, find_importers, get_logic_slice and get_pr_impact entries; `contextBoundaryViolations` on get_pr_impact; `contextDrift` on get_why_context. `ctxo index` writes `.ctxo/index/domain/`.
- Doctor: `domain_registry` (also names unknown keys under `domain:` with a "did you mean" suggestion), `domain_agent_setup`, `domain_conventions`, and `install_copies` (MCP entry and hooks start the same copy). Feature doc: docs/features/domain-knowledge.md ("Ctxo domain conventions v1").

## Unreleased: language parity for TypeScript, Java and Go (#156, PR 1C)

- Capability matrix (annotations / test symbols / SQL at call sites, the last only with `@ctxo/lang-sql` installed): C# attributes / test methods / ADO.NET, Dapper, SqlBulkCopy, EF Core raw SQL (Roslyn tier); TypeScript decorators / test blocks / pg, mysql2, mssql, knex.raw, Prisma raw, TypeORM, Sequelize, better-sqlite3; Java annotations (JDT constant values, tree-sitter strings only) / test methods under src/test/java / JDBC, Spring JdbcTemplate, JPA native queries, native @Query, MyBatis (JDT full tier); Go struct tags (both tiers) / `_test.go` functions (full tier) / database/sql, sqlx, pgx, gorm raw (analyzer full tier).
- Annotation formats: TypeScript `@Injectable()` gives `{ name: 'Injectable' }`; a property decorator `@Column({ name: 'member_id' }) memberId` gives `{ name: 'Column', named: { member: 'memberId', name: 'member_id' } }` on the class. Java: the `value` member goes to `args`, other members to `named`, enum constants as `Type.MEMBER`. Go: each tagged field gives `{ name: 'tag', named: { member: 'LoanID', json: 'loan_id', gorm: 'column:loan_id' } }` on its struct. C# caps everywhere (20 per symbol, 10 args, 10 named, 200 chars); a key named `type` is dropped; `named.member` is reserved only in TypeScript and Go.
- TypeScript test blocks: in files matching `**/__tests__/**`, `**/*.test.*`, `**/*.spec.*`, `**/test/**`, `**/tests/**` or an `index.tests` glob (the CLI hands plugins the defaults plus `index.tests` as `PluginContext.testGlobs`; older CLIs: defaults only), each describe/it/test block is a `function` symbol named by its title path, for example `src/loans/loan-policy.test.ts::LoanPolicy > renewal > extends by seven days::function`, annotated `{ name: 'test' }`, with its own callback's edges; a repeated path gets ` #2`, ` #3`.
- SQL at call sites: constant SQL only, parsed by `@ctxo/sql-extract`, edges to the same 2-part targets as C# and `.sql` files (`dbo.loans::table`). TypeScript ties the receiver to the listed npm module through a provenance walk (at most 8 steps); Java matches the receiver type, its supertypes or the imports; Go matches the callee's method object. Java and Go need their full tier.
- Tests now count as blast-radius dependents, so the safe-edit gate may fire more often on well-tested symbols. find_dead_code uses the shared test-file classifier: test symbols are never dead and Go functions called only from tests are no longer reported.
- The first re-index after upgrading rewrites committed index JSON for TypeScript, Java and Go files once; run a full `ctxo index`. The three plugins stay on protocol '1', so older CLIs keep loading them.

## New in v0.13

### Tiered agent rules, granular init, agent-setup doctor checks (#159)

- Two rules tiers inside versioned markers (`<!-- ctxo-rules-start v<version> -->` / `<!-- ctxo-rules-end -->`). Claude Code gets a compact block (4 lines in `CLAUDE.md`) when the safe-edit guard hook, all three skills and an enabled gate (`gate.enabled` not false) are in place; every other client, and Claude Code without them, gets the full block. The full block's first rule is narrowed: "For structural questions (dependencies, impact, history), use ctxo tools first; reading a file to see its contents needs no index call." When the domain layer is set up (a `domain` key in `.ctxo/config.yaml` or the default registry `docs/domain/contexts.yaml`, both committed; otherwise a loaded `@ctxo/domain`), both tiers add one line: "Adopting or tuning the domain layer? Run `ctxo domain discover` first (`--json` for the evidence, `--write` to merge the proposal)."; otherwise the block is unchanged (template version stays 0.13), and `ai_rules` / `doctor --fix` handle a block whose line does not match that state.
- The rules writer replaces the ctxo block in place in every rules file (versioned, unversioned or the old unmarked body), collapses duplicates, keeps everything outside the block (BOM and line endings included), and leaves a block from a newer ctxo or a damaged block (a start or end marker without its partner) unchanged with a warning. `ctxo-understand` carries a question-to-tool table for all 14 tools.
- Blocks and skills are written in Prettier's layout and compared with formatting ignored (line endings, BOM, trailing whitespace, blank lines, table padding, line wrapping), so a markdown formatter and ctxo never rewrite each other. The compact block is at most 8 non-blank lines including the markers (6 today).
- A rules file several clients share (an `AGENTS.md` or `GEMINI.md` hard-linked or symlinked to `CLAUDE.md`) gets the full block; init and doctor treat it as one file.
- Each bundled skill ends with `<!-- ctxo-skill v<version> -->`; a skill from a newer ctxo is left alone and not reported as outdated.
- No silent opt-out: init (real run, dry run, `--only rules`, `--rules`) and `doctor --fix` leave a pre-tier or compact block unchanged while the guard or skills it expects are missing and not declined, with the warning `<file>: left unchanged until the guard and skills are installed; run "ctxo init --only rules,skills,guard" or "ctxo doctor --fix"`. A file linked to a held one is held too.
- `ctxo init` parts: `rules`, `skills`, `guard`, `mcp`, `git-hooks`, `config`. New flags `--only <parts>`, `--skip <parts>`, `--no-guard` (does not install the guard); `--rules` is a deprecated alias for `--skip git-hooks,guard`. `-y` without `--tools` sets up all nine tools. `--dry-run` lists every file init would create or change. A corrupt or oddly shaped `.claude/settings.json` is never overwritten.
- New doctor checks `ai_rules`, `skills` and `claude_guard_hook` (warn only). `ctxo doctor --fix` installs the skills and the guard, then re-renders the rules blocks; it holds a block by the same rule as init, installs nothing the user declined (a versioned full block or `gate.enabled: false`), and replaces edited ctxo skills with the bundled copy.

### Contexts view, plugin protocol v2 and T-SQL data coupling (#156)

- **Contexts view (#156)** - `ctxo index` writes `.ctxo/index/contexts-view.json`: candidate bounded contexts from file-level clustering of dependency and co-change edges, with hub files damped. Each candidate has a suggested label, cohesion, top terms, cross-candidate edges and co-change pairs; type names with different shapes in different candidates are listed as collisions. Recomputed on every index run that re-indexes files (and every post-commit hook run); skipped by `--skip-community`; not refreshed by `ctxo watch`.
- `get_architectural_overlay` `mode: "contexts"` returns a summary of all candidates (hubs and collisions capped at 50); `candidate: <id>` returns one candidate in full. `mode` (overlay), `searchMode` (get_ranked_context) and `mode` (search_symbols) are now registered, so clients can send them. The unused `fuzzy` parameter is gone (typo correction is automatic in `fts` mode).
- `ctxo contexts [--json]` - candidates as a table (stderr) or the full artifact (stdout).
- New config in `.ctxo/config.yaml`: `communities:` (resolution, godNodeMinBridged, godNodeMaxResults), `contextsView:` (weights, exclude, hubs, resolution, minCandidateFiles, technicalTerms) and `index.tests` (extra test globs).
- **Plugin protocol v2 (#156)** - new symbol kinds `table`, `view`, `procedure` and edge kinds `reads`, `writes`, `executes`; typed symbol `annotations` (`name`, `args`, `named`); code facts on request (`index.facts: true`); host capabilities (`facts`, `sqlCallSites`). The CLI loads plugins declaring `apiVersion` '1' or '2'; a plugin declares the lowest version it works on.
- **`@ctxo/lang-sql`** - `ctxo install sql` (alias `tsql`). T-SQL definitions become symbols (tables with a `columns` annotation); view, procedure and function bodies give reads/writes/executes edges to canonical `schema.name` targets (default `dbo`). T-SQL only; top-level DML in scripts is skipped. Suggested by detection when the repository has at least 5 `.sql` files that are also at least 2% of its files.
- **SQL size limit** - a `.sql` file larger than 5 MiB is skipped with one warning (`skipped <file>: <n> MiB is over the 5 MiB SQL size limit`) and gets no symbols or edges, so a data dump cannot crash `ctxo index`.
- **SQL at C# call sites** - with lang-sql installed and the .NET SDK 8+, constant SQL at ADO.NET, Dapper (including the `CommandDefinition` constructor), `SqlBulkCopy` and EF Core raw SQL call sites becomes data edges (ScriptDom). Use `const string`; `static readonly` SQL is invisible. The C# plugin also reports attribute annotations (10 named entries plus the reserved `type`).
- **Data coupling** - data edges are `confirmed` blast-radius dependents (the gate guards heavily used tables) and stay out of symbol-level communities; `.sql` symbols are never dead code. The contexts view adds `dataResources` and per-candidate `sharedTables` (ownership, external resources); `contextsView.weights.data` defaults to 0. Overlay summary: `sharedTableCount`, `dataResourcesTotal`, `sharedResourcesTotal`, `externalResourcesTotal`; `candidate: <id>` detail: up to 15 `sharedTables` and 15 `dataResources`, fewer when the response limit requires.
- **Procedures in the contexts view** - a stored procedure's reads and writes count for the candidates that execute it (by canonical name), not for the candidate holding the script; a procedure nobody executes credits its own candidate. With several copies, the bodies of every production copy count (the winner's alone when no copy is production), and docs and test copies add nothing when a production copy exists. A C# class and a same-name table can show up as a collision (possible noise).
- **One identity per data resource** - when several files define a table, view or procedure, references resolve to a copy outside test files, then outside docs folders, then the codepoint-smallest path (`index.tests` is not consulted). Every copy, and the 2-part ID (`dbo.loans::table`), gives the same dependents in get_blast_radius, find_importers, get_pr_impact, get_context_for_task, the gate and `ctxo blast-radius`. get_logic_slice walks each copy's own body (the winner's for a 2-part ID); get_why_context with a 2-part ID reads the winner's file history.
- **Annotations in MCP output** - get_logic_slice includes node `annotations` at L4 only; L1-L3 and get_context_for_task omit them.
- **Test files by annotation** - `Fact`, `Theory`, `SkippableFact`, `SkippableTheory`, `Test`, `TestCase`, `TestCaseSource`, `TestFixture`, `TestMethod`, `DataTestMethod`, `TestClass` mark test files; name-only `*Test.cs` / `*Tests.cs` matches need one once C# annotations exist. Attributes derived from a known one (`[LoanFact]` from `Xunit.FactAttribute`) count in the Roslyn tier (the plugin adds the base's annotation, `named.via` the derived class), not in the tree-sitter tier; bare capital `Tests/` folders are not recognised: add `index.tests`. Run a full `ctxo index` after upgrading `@ctxo/lang-csharp`.
- **`csharp_tier` doctor check** - warns when the Roslyn helper cannot restore its NuGet packages (ScriptDom); the C# plugin then falls back to tree-sitter. The helper declares `RollForward` `Major`, so it can run on a newer .NET runtime when no .NET 8 runtime is installed. `ctxo watch` restarts an idle or crashed Roslyn keep-alive once and falls back to tree-sitter if that fails, instead of writing a C# file with zero symbols.

### Co-change engine, incremental indexing, one snapshot per commit (#157)

- Co-change is built from one `git log` pass with its own window, independent of `--max-history` (which controls per-file intent depth only). Config: `cochange:` in `.ctxo/config.yaml` (maxCommits 2000 or "all", since, maxFilesPerCommit 30, minShared 2, include, exclude). Overrides: `ctxo index --cochange-commits <n|all>`, `--cochange-since <duration>`. Merge commits are excluded; commits above `maxFilesPerCommit` are skipped and counted (`massSkipped`); renames are followed.
- Every blast-radius path uses co-change: get_blast_radius, get_pr_impact, get_context_for_task, `ctxo blast-radius`, the safe-edit gate hook and `ctxo gate --preview`. `likely` includes co-change-upgraded dependents, `coChangeFrequency` is filled, and get_blast_radius adds `coChangedFiles` (up to 10 files, informational). The gate may fire somewhat more often.
- Incremental indexing: `ctxo index --files <path...>` (alias `--file`) and `ctxo index --commit <rev>` re-index part of the index and recompute everything global from the merged index. The v2 post-commit hook runs `ctxo index --commit HEAD` once per commit, guarded by `[ -d .ctxo ]`. `ctxo init` and `ctxo doctor --fix` upgrade old hook blocks in place and refuse to write into a global or system `core.hooksPath`. New `git_hooks` doctor check.
- One community snapshot per commit. Drift and boundary confidence count `distinctCommits` (low below 3, medium 3-6, high 7+). `ctxo index --check` records no snapshot.
- `ctxo <command> --help` prints help and runs nothing.

## New in v0.8

- **Safe-edit guard** - a PreToolUse hook (Claude Code) that blocks edits to high-impact symbols until the agent checks blast radius. Installed by `ctxo init`. Configure via `gate:` in `.ctxo/config.yaml` (sensitivity: strict|balanced|lenient).
- `ctxo blast-radius <symbolId> --json` - compute blast radius for one symbol, JSON to stdout (CI scripts, jq pipelines)
- `ctxo gate --preview [--json]` - preview which symbols the guard would flag at the current sensitivity
- Three model-invoked skills (`ctxo-understand`, `ctxo-safe-edit`, `ctxo-review-pr`) installed to `.claude/skills/` (Claude Code) and `.cursor/rules/` (Cursor)

## New in v0.7

- `ctxo install` — install language plugin packages
- `ctxo update` — check npm for newer @ctxo/cli + plugins; auto-execute or print install command
- `ctxo init` — project-aware language detection + plugin wiring
- `ctxo index --install-missing` — auto-install missing plugins during index
- `ctxo doctor --fix` — repair common issues
- `ctxo version` subcommand; `ctxo --version --verbose|--json` for plugin/runtime details

## Key Concepts

- Symbol ID format: "file::name::kind" (e.g., "src/foo.ts::myFn::function", "db/lending.sql::dbo.loans::table")
- Symbol kinds: function, class, interface, method, variable, type, table, view, procedure
- Edge kinds: imports, calls, extends, implements, uses, reads, writes, executes (data edges point at 2-part names such as "dbo.loans::table")
- All responses include _meta: { totalItems, returnedItems, truncated, totalBytes }
- 4 tools support intent filtering: get_blast_radius, get_logic_slice, find_importers, find_dead_code
- Large responses auto-truncated at 8KB (configurable via CTXO_RESPONSE_LIMIT)
